static_dimensions.description: A static categorical attribute of the user that remains fixed during the CBT session with the therapist. Reflects primary and comorbid clinical diagnoses (e.g., panic disorder, OCD, depression, BPD, AUD).
A static categorical attribute of the user that describes stable disposition, emotional sensitivity, reactivity, and personality traits relevant for CBT.

A static categorical attribute encompassing demographic (age, gender, relationship status, occupation) and sociocultural identity (race/ethnicity, culture, socioeconomic status, religion, minority status) relevant to engagement and symptom presentation.

static_dimensions.dimension_name: Core Beliefs and Cognitive Appraisal Style
static_dimensions.description: A static categorical attribute representing stable core beliefs and habitual cognitive patterns (e.g., self-worth, perfectionism, catastrophic thinking).
A static categorical attribute indicating typical (often maladaptive) coping strategies used to manage emotion and distress.
A static categorical attribute reflecting the context and history of the user's therapy experience.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state of the user that may change during the CBT session depending on responses and interventions. Captures present emotional tone and reactivity.
options: high negative affect (anxious, sad, irritable, shameful)
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update when the user discusses triggering events, shows shifts during exposures, or responds to emotional processing or mindfulness practices.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic categorical state representing the user's participatory stance, willingness, and openness within the session.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update in response to therapist interventions (e.g., motivational interviewing), session structure (group vs. individual), shifts after successes/setbacks, or during challenging tasks (e.g., exposure, homework review).

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic state reflecting the user's readiness and motivation to pursue behavioral or cognitive change in therapy.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update when the user expresses change in attitude, discusses pros/cons of change, after successes/failures, or following motivational interventions.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic state describing the user's current use of avoidance and safety behaviors within or outside sessions.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update during or after exposures, behavioral experiments, or when user reflects on homework or coping in response to emotional triggers.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic state denoting the user's present ability to recognize, reflect on, and challenge automatic thoughts/core beliefs.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update after cognitive restructuring, insight-building exercises, or as user discusses changing perspective on thoughts/emotions.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic state describing the user's application of emotion regulation and mindfulness skills in session.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update following skills training, mindfulness practice, emotion exposures, or user report of coping between sessions.

dynamic_dimensions.description: A dynamic state tracking the user's completion of and engagement with therapy homework and assigned tasks.
dynamic_dimensions.update_condition: Update following homework review, session check-ins, or when barriers/supports to adherence are addressed.
